verdict.rationale: Navan documents two in-product assistants. Ava analyzes and summarizes spend data and proactively finds savings, but it is analytics-only. Navan Edge lets users book, change, or cancel flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations by chat, with explicit confirmation before acting. However, Edge is reserved for the most frequent travelers and is also staffed by human agents, so the evidence does not clearly show AI-driven task execution for all users. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Edge's booking actions are performed by an AI agent rather than human agents, delegation of non-travel tasks (e.g., expense filing or approvals) to the built-in assistant, availability beyond the top-traveler tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations by chatting with Navan Edge.
Navan Edge will always ask for your explicit confirmation before booking, changing, or canceling any trip.
Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions, and proactively finds opportunities for savings.
